name: Fractal Glass
description: Create a striped glass effect with Gaussian blur, a custom striped texture, clipping, monochromatic noise and levels.

controls.name: mode
controls.label: Rendering mode
controls.description: Default combines blur, striped refraction, noise and levels. Optical preserves the rounded physical glass renderer.

controls.name: smoothness
controls.label: Glass smoothness
controls.description: Smooth the repeated gradient texture before deriving its refracting slope. Default mode only.

controls.name: textureScale
controls.label: Texture scale (%)
controls.description: Scale the repeated texture. 100% uses the base texture scale; larger values make wider strips.

controls.name: blackPoint
controls.label: Levels black point
controls.description: Input black point for the glass copy, after noise. Default mode only.

controls.name: whitePoint
controls.label: Levels white point
controls.description: Input white point for the glass copy. Default mode only.

controls.name: gamma
controls.label: Levels gamma
controls.description: Adjust glass midtones after noise. One preserves midtones; greater values brighten them.

controls.name: edgeWidth
controls.label: Glass stroke (px)
controls.description: Optional inside stroke, scaled from a 1080px reference. Disabled by default for a clean glass boundary.

controls.name: stripes
controls.label: Stripes
controls.description: Repeated gradient strips across the full image. Default 26; texture scale adjusts their spacing.

controls.name: distortion
controls.label: Distortion
controls.description: Glass displacement strength. Default 24; optical mode measures displacement in CSS pixels.

controls.name: refractionBias
controls.label: Refraction direction
controls.description: Orient refraction within every strip: -1 left, 0 centered, 1 right. The source is offset back automatically to keep the image aligned. Intermediate values blend directions; horizontal strips use up/down.

controls.name: blur
controls.label: Gaussian blur
controls.description: Blur the image copy before Glass. Default mode pixels scale from a 1080px reference; optical mode uses CSS pixels.

controls.name: relief
controls.label: Relief
controls.description: Height of the rounded flutes. Analytic surface normals guide refraction and reflections.

controls.name: refraction
controls.label: Refraction
controls.description: Strength of source-image refraction through the rounded surface, using IOR 1.46.

controls.name: roughness
controls.label: Roughness
controls.description: Broaden studio highlights and soften transmission from polished to frosted glass.

controls.name: reflection
controls.label: Reflection
controls.description: Strength of the soft environment reflections mixed with image transmission.

controls.name: dispersion
controls.label: Dispersion
controls.description: Separate red and blue transmission along the refracted ray for subtle prism fringes.

controls.name: caustics
controls.label: Caustics
controls.description: Concentrate or spread transmitted light where neighboring refracted rays converge or diverge. Disabled by default for clear glass.

controls.name: grain
controls.label: Grain
controls.description: Uniform monochromatic noise applied after Glass. Default 0.005 (0.5%); 0.02 applies 2% noise.

controls.name: coverage
controls.label: Glass coverage
controls.description: Fraction covered by glass. Continuous clips freely; By stripe advances through whole divisions. Zero is clear; one covers the full image.

controls.name: coverageMode
controls.label: Coverage mode
controls.description: Continuous preserves the free boundary. By stripe uses a hybrid of soft left-to-right sweeps within each strip and opacity controlled by Transition fade. Divisions keep independent animation clocks while dragging.

controls.name: side
controls.label: Glass side
controls.description: Starting edge of the covered section. In Reveal on hover, Left reveals left to right and Right reveals right to left, including each strip’s sweep. Horizontal By stripe coverage uses top/bottom.

controls.name: direction
controls.label: Stripe direction
controls.description: Choose vertical or horizontal glass flutes.

controls.name: hoverPreset
controls.label: Hover preset
controls.description: Glass on hover starts clear and applies glass over the left 44%. Reveal on hover sets full coverage with Glass side Right: glass rests fully applied, hover reveals the original right to left, and recovery reverses direction by default. Both restore interaction defaults; coverage, side and recovery direction remain editable. Spread the exported fractalGlassPresets map to reuse the presets.

controls.name: hoverEffect
controls.label: Hover effect
controls.description: Enable hover interaction. Procedural and Transition activate inside the covered section. Circular glass activates anywhere on the image. Keyboard focus and touch taps also activate the effect.

controls.name: hoverAnimation
controls.label: Hover animation
controls.description: Procedural combines strip sweeps and opacity; Transition uses one global transition. Circular glass follows the pointer anywhere on the image, showing distortion only inside a soft circle, independently of coverage and Hover preset. Keyboard focus centers the circle; touch taps place and toggle it.

controls.name: recoveryDirection
controls.label: Recovery direction
controls.description: Direction of glass restoration on exit from procedural Reveal on hover. Reverse reveal follows the opposite direction of Glass side; Same as reveal follows it. Explicit left-to-right/right-to-left settings work independently. Both the per-strip sweep and vertical curtain order follow the selection. Interrupted transitions blend from their current mask without resetting progress.

controls.name: hoverDuration
controls.label: Hover stripe (ms)
controls.description: Time for each procedural strip transition or for the circular glass fade. Default 880ms; lower values move faster. Zero immediately shows the active state.

controls.name: hoverRadius
controls.label: Circle radius (px)
controls.description: Radius of the circular hover in CSS pixels. It stays circular across image sizes and pixel densities.

controls.name: hoverFeather
controls.label: Circle softness (px)
controls.description: Soft edge inside the circular hover, from 0 to 300 CSS pixels. Zero gives a sharp circle; larger values blend glass into the original, up to the circle radius.

controls.name: disabled
controls.label: Disabled
controls.description: Show the original image and immediately stop the transition.

controls.name: transitionBlend
controls.label: Transition fade
controls.description: Mix the soft left-to-right sweep within each strip with whole-strip opacity for By stripe coverage and Procedural hover. Zero emphasizes the sweep; one uses opacity only; 0.5 blends both.

controls.name: duration
controls.label: Transition (ms)
controls.description: Duration of coverage wipes and Transition hover. Zero disables animation, including the procedural reveal. Reduced motion shows a static final state.

controls.name: ease
controls.label: Easing curve
controls.description: Timing curve for coverage and both hover animations. Power4 out starts quickly and slows smoothly into place. Smoothstep retains the earlier hover curve; none is linear. Hover staggering adapts to the curve so strips remain closely overlapped. Changes keep independent clocks and current progress.

controls.name: height
controls.label: Height (px)
controls.description: Preview height. The component defaults to a responsive 1.5 aspect ratio when omitted.

controls.name: borderRadius
controls.label: Border radius (px)
controls.description: Clip the image, glass and foreground to the same rounded surface.

controls.name: animateEntrance
controls.label: Animate entrance
controls.description: Fade in over 800 ms after the first complete image or frame is ready. Set false for an immediate entrance. Respects prefers-reduced-motion.
